name: Close a month with mailbox hits and a bank fee
query: Mach meinen September fertig. Mein Gmail ist verbunden.
expected_behavior: Converts September to dateFrom 2026-09-01 and dateTo 2026-09-30 (or the prior year's September if today's date says so) and states the period
Calls list_transactions, list_transactions_needing_files and list_transactions_missing_invoice, paging nextCursor until it is null
Opens with one short table: Transactions, with Beleg, still without, receipt only
Calls list_files with hasConnections false and hasSuggestions true and shows existing Vorschläge with their match confidence before searching mail
Asks one confirmation for the whole batch of Zuordnungen, then calls connect_file_to_transaction per confirmed pair
Searches Gmail for the remaining Transactions largest amount first, using vendor, the amount as both 39,90 and 39.90, and a window of 10 days before to 45 days after
Skips newsletters, Bestellbestätigungen, Mahnungen and Gutschriften
Uploads found PDFs through scripts/fibuki-upload.mjs (or upload_file with a url) and re-reads the Files for new Vorschläge instead of connecting by its own judgement
Proposes Kategorien ohne Beleg for bank fees as one batch with a reason per line, then assign_no_receipt_category after confirmation
Ends with what was done in numbers, what is still open (Partner, amount, date) and one next step
success_criteria: Never asks for confirmation per item
Never writes anything the user did not confirm in that turn
Never computes or states a match score of its own
Reports where it looked for each missing Beleg, including 'nothing found'
Uses German terms (Beleg, Zuordnung, Kategorie ohne Beleg) and Euro with a decimal comma
